summary: First backend test iteration for Project Life. Wrote a pytest suite (24 tests, 100% pass) covering auth guard, invalid session_id rejection, /auth/me, profile update, phases list + locking, phase-advance requirement gating, phase-advance success flow (consent + contact -> phase 0 -> 1), journal CRUD + insights (entry_count, avg_mood, top_words), weekly check-ins, safety net (contacts CRUD, safety check-in, today lookup, crisis resources = 4), therapist uploads (base64 stripped in list), memories (no phase gate confirmed), session logs, 8 seeded somatic practices with unlock_phase, trauma-map timeline, and logout invalidation (subsequent /auth/me -> 401). MongoDB _id exclusion verified recursively on every response. Google OAuth flow is MOCKED by inserting the QA user + session directly into MongoDB (as instructed). No issues found in the backend.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not require an Authorization header; an unauthenticated call returns 200 {ok: true}. Behaviour is idempotent and safe, but consider requiring a valid bearer token to make the contract explicit.
'today' window uses UTC midnight (now_utc().replace(hour=0,...)) which will feel off-by-one for users in non-UTC timezones. Acceptable for MVP; document or accept a client tz offset later.

action_items: (Optional) Require a valid bearer token on POST /api/auth/logout to enforce a stricter auth contract.
(Optional) Accept a client timezone offset (or ISO date) for GET /api/safety/checkin/today so 'today' matches the user's local day.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 740-line module; still readable but consider splitting into routers (auth, phases, journal, safety, uploads, practices) once more endpoints are added.
All list endpoints correctly project out {'_id': 0}; therapist-uploads list also nulls file_base64 to keep payloads small — good.

compute_phase_progress logic for phase 1 uses `min(int((checkins/4)*60) + min(uploads*40, 40), 100)` — combined cap works but is slightly harder to reason about; consider a small comment explaining the 60/40 split.

advance_phase does not require user.consent_accepted or onboarding_complete explicitly — it relies on compute_phase_progress==100. That is fine for phase 0 (consent + contact = 100) but there is no explicit onboarding_complete gate; acceptable per PRD.
get_current_user re-normalizes naive expires_at to UTC — good defensive handling for older docs.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py seeds a QA user (user_id=user_qatest, email=qa@projectlife.local) and session (session_token=qa-token-xyz, 7-day expiry) directly in MongoDB to simulate Google OAuth. All data prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up on session teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is Emergent Google OAuth (session_id -> session_token). Real OAuth cannot be exercised from the container; use the MongoDB seeding pattern in /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (qa_user fixture) to obtain an authenticated bearer token. All 24 backend tests currently pass against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Test file is idempotent and cleans up its own data.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA — MVP backend behaves as specified.
